title: UpsertContract
description: A public procurement contract — primarily TED (EU Tenders Electronic Daily) award notices. Linked to its contracting Authority via authority_id and to the awarded Company (vendor) via company_gmr_id. Sinks materialise AWARDED (Authority→Contract) and AWARDED_TO (Contract→Company) edges from those keys.

ted_notice_id.description: TED notice ID (or other procurement source notice ID). For eForms-format notices this is the cbc:ID root identifier — a UUID assigned by the publishing system before TED has materialised a publication-number.

ted_publication_number.description: TED publication-number assigned at publish time (e.g. '295342-2026'). The ETL resolves this via TED's v3 search API so downstream readers can build the canonical detail URL (https://ted.europa.eu/en/notice/-/detail/<publication-number>) directly. Null when the notice is queued but not yet published, or when the search API had no match at ETL time — readers fall back to the runtime lookup endpoint in that case.

value_eur.description: Awarded contract value in EUR (converted at publication date). This is the value the loader chose to trust — the eForms NoticeResult TotalAmount, falling back to the per-award PayableAmount — not necessarily either raw field verbatim.

value_currency.description: Original ISO 4217 currency before EUR conversion.

value_original.description: Chosen awarded value in the original currency.

value_before_eur.description: On a modification (can-modif), the pre-modification contract total in EUR, converted at the same publication-date rate as value_eur so the before->after delta isolates the value change from FX drift. Populated from legacy TED F20 notices, which self-contain both totals; eForms modifications carry the before via the MODIFIES link to the original.

value_before_original.description: The pre-modification total (VAL_TOTAL_BEFORE) in the original currency; paired with value_original (the after total).

estimated_value_eur.description: The lot/notice EstimatedOverallContractAmount in EUR — the independently-entered budget estimate, kept as the primary cross-check for the value confidence score.

value_payable_eur.description: The per-award PayableAmount in EUR — kept as a secondary cross-check. Frequently equals value_eur, but diverges when the source corrupts one field (see value_payable_discrepancy).

value_confidence.description: Confidence in value_eur, in [0,1]: consistency (agreement of the chosen value with the estimate and payable) × plausibility (soft absolute magnitude bound). Derived by contract_confidence.score_contract_value.

value_confidence_consistency.description: Consistency sub-score: weighted log-space agreement of the chosen value with the estimate (full weight) and payable (down-weighted).

value_confidence_plausibility.description: Plausibility sub-score: soft absolute EUR magnitude bound (1.0 up to ~1B, decaying to 0 by ~300B).

value_quality_flag.description: Why the value is (or is not) trustworthy.

value_low_confidence.description: True when value_confidence is below the platform threshold (0.5). Consumers exclude such contracts from default value aggregates while keeping the record available.

value_payable_discrepancy.description: True when the source PayableAmount disagrees with the stored value by more than ~5x — an internal source inconsistency, surfaced even when the contract is otherwise kept (e.g. the Forca Aerea aircraft, total EUR 7.27M but payable EUR 7.27B).

value_quarantined.description: True when the platform withheld the monetary fields because the published value failed hard sanity checks (see value_quarantine_reason). The claimed value survives in the event log and the review queue; sinks REMOVE any previously rendered monetary props.

match_tier.description: How company_gmr_id was resolved: lei | vat | cik (exact ID) vs name_country | fuzzy (name-based). Stamped on the AWARDED_TO edge so exact and inferred attributions are distinguishable in queries + UI.

match_confidence.description: Resolver confidence for the company match (1.0 lei, 0.99 vat/cik, 0.95 name_country, <0.95 fuzzy).

match_layer.description: TedMatcher layer that produced the match (1 vat-cache, 2 resolve hard/name, 3 resolve fuzzy, 5 new node).

value_quarantine_reason.description: Why the value was withheld: implausible_magnitude | concession_negative | unverified_single_signal (review-queued) or zero_value (auto: a published 0 is non-disclosure).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the contracting authority (the acquirer). Cascaded onto the Contract at write time because TED contracts are jurisdictionally grouped by the procuring entity, not the awarded vendor.

procedure_type.description: eForms procurement-procedure-type code (e.g. open, restricted, neg-w-call, neg-wo-call). Drives the non-open / no-call-for-bids red flags.

procedure_id.description: eForms procedure-identifier (UUID). Shared by an award notice and its contract-modification (can-modif) notices; link_ted_modifications joins on it to build MODIFIES edges. Stamped by the TED incremental search-API loader.

notice_type.description: eForms notice-type (e.g. can-standard, can-modif). 'can-modif' marks a contract-modification notice.

modifies_publication_number.description: On a modification (can-modif), the original award's publication-number (or notice identifier) it modifies. Provenance for the MODIFIES link; the join itself uses procedure_id.

tenders_received.description: Number of tenders received for the award's lot. A value of 1 is the single-bidder red flag (the headline EC Single Market Scoreboard indicator).

award_criterion_type.description: price = lowest-price-only award; meat = most-economically-advantageous-tender (any quality/cost criterion). Price-only is a CRI red flag.

submission_deadline.description: Tender submission cut-off date — with publication_date, yields the submission-period / decision-speed indicators.

is_framework.description: True when the notice sets up a framework agreement (excluded from some single-bidder denominators).

eu_funded.description: True when the notice declares EU co-financing (cohesion / RRF etc.). Null when no funding block is present (unknown, not 'definitely not').

funding_programme.description: Declared EU funding programme code when eu_funded.

current_value.description: Collapsed value of the underlying contract in EUR: the latest restated value across the original award and its contract-modification (can-modif) notices, or the award value when never modified. Materialised by the collapse_modifications ETL pass. Value aggregates sum this over is_current nodes so each contract counts once.

is_current.description: True on the single canonical :Contract node per underlying contract (the award, or the latest modification when the award was never ingested). Value/count aggregates include is_current nodes only; superseded modification restatements are false. Absent on never-modified nodes, which readers default to canonical.

contract_key.description: Stable identity the collapse_modifications pass grouped a contract's award + modification notices under (procedure_id, else the modified/own publication reference).
